name: CP-12 (APEX 1.0)

surface_window.note: The landing date is not published.

outcome_note: Will deliver three NASA CLPS payloads to Schrödinger Basin.

payloads.name: Farside Seismic Suite
payloads.purpose: Two seismometers testing whether far-side seismicity differs from the near side.

payloads.name: Lunar Interior Temperature and Materials Suite
payloads.purpose: Heat-flow probe and magnetotelluric sounder for crustal heat flow and interior conductivity.

payloads.name: LuSEE-Lite
payloads.purpose: Measures the electric and magnetic field and plasma environment at the surface.

sources.title: Commercial Lunar Payload Services (CLPS) Deliveries (page updated May 06, 2026)

notes: The target coordinate is the IAU centre of Schrödinger crater, not a published landing point.

site.name: Schrödinger (feature centre)
site.source_note: The IAU centre of Schrödinger, used because no landing point is published. It is not a landing point, and numbers here describe the centre of the named feature. No elevation model covers this site: height, slope and terrain are not modelled.

notes: Mission facts are compiled by hand from NASA pages, LROC images and the IAU Gazetteer; every record carries its sources, last read 2026-09-23.
1 of 1 missions have fields no source confirms; they are listed as unconfirmed, never filled in.
Numbers are Sun and Earth geometry at the target over the mission's surface window, not what any lander measured.
1 target(s) lie outside the 80-90 deg S elevation model; there Sun and Earth are computed against a smooth sphere, so terrain could block more.
Where no landing point is published, the target is the IAU centre of the named feature, which is not a landing point.
